structure.unit: Virginia Coal Surface Mining Control and Reclamation Act of 1979

law.catch_line: Resisting, etc., Director or agent of the Director; penalty
law.text: It is a misdemeanor, punishable by a fine of not more than $5,000, confinement in jail for not more than one year, or both, for any person, except as permitted by law, to willfully resist, prevent, impede, or interfere with the Director or any agent of the Director in the performance of duties pursuant to this chapter.
